title: How long they worked together
summary: They worked together about five years, '47 to '50; Marian's style.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: So that your working together really then was a very short lived thing wasn't it?
Oh, about five years? Because I didn't have a time perspective there.

Yes. Well we travelled all over the Country. But I decided finally that she was good enough now and she had the beat good enough and she was playing well enough to go to New York. And let the big boys hear her.

I remember my own shock when I saw her on television for the first time because I had known about Marian McPartland and this jazz piano. And I'm like Leonard Feather, in a way, but I saw her walk out on that stage and she was white, I couldn't get over it. (LAUGHTER).
I really couldn't get over it. (LAUGHTER).
You know we were talking about I don't know how we got on that journey.
Well no, we got to Achen you
remember and so then I said, I thought it was a perfect time for you to talk about Marian because you were married over there.
We were talking about Billie Holiday I think before that.
Yes, yes. And then we moved from that on to ......
